chapterInfo.content:
18
Yuda de asraafoɔ ba bɛkyere Yesu
(Mateo 26.47-56; Marko 14.43-52; Luka 22.47-53)
1 # Mat 26.36; Mar 14.32; Luka 22.39; 2 Sa 15.23 Yesu kaa yeinom no, ɔne n’asuafoɔ no firii adi kɔtwaa Asuo Kidron faako a turo bi wɔ, na ɔne n’asuafoɔ no kɔɔ mu. 2#Luka 21.37 Na Yuda nso a ɔyii no maeɛ no nim hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na Yesu ne n’asuafoɔ no taa kɔhyia hɔ. 3Ɛnna Yuda de asraafokuo ne asomfoɔ a wɔfiri asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Farisifoɔ no nkyɛn baa hɔ; wɔkurakura ntɛnee, nkanea ne akodeɛ. 4#Yoh 19.28 Ɛnna Yesu a ɔnim deɛ ɛreba ne so nyinaa no firii adie, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Morehwehwɛ hwan? 5Wɔbuaa no sɛ: Yesu, Nasareni no. Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Meni! Nso Yuda a ɔyii no maeɛ no nso ne wɔn na ɛgyina hɔ. 6Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Meni! no, wɔpimpinii akyire, na wɔhwehwee ase. 7Ɛnna ɔbisaa wɔn bio sɛ: Morehwehwɛ hwan? Na wɔse: Yesu, Nasareni no. 8Yesu buaa sɛ: Maka makyerɛ mo sɛ meni; enti sɛ me na morehwehwɛ me a, momma yeinom nkɔ! 9#Yoh 6.39; 17.12 Sɛ asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ: Wɔn a wode wɔn ama me no, mamma wɔn mu biara anyera, no mmra mu.
10Ɛnna Simon Petro a ɔkura nkrantɛ no tweeɛ, na ɔde bɔɔ ɔsɔfo panin no akoa, na ɔtwaa n’aso nifa; na akoa no din de Malko. 11#Mat 26.39 Ɛnna Yesu see Petro sɛ: Fa nkrantɛ no hyɛ bɔha mu! Kuruwa a m’Agya de ama me no, mennnom anaa?
Wɔde Yesu kɔgyina Ɔsɔfo panin anim
(Mateo 26.57-75; Marko 14.53-72; Luka 22.54-71)
12Ɛnna asraafokuo no ne wɔn safohene ne Yudafoɔ asomfoɔ no sɔɔ Yesu mu, na wɔkyekyeree no, 13na wɔde no kɔɔ Hana nkyɛn kane; na Kaiafa a ɔdi afe no mu sɔfo panin ase ne no. 14#Yoh 11.49-50 Nso Kaiafa no ne deɛ ɔtuu Yudafoɔ no fo sɛ: Ɛyɛ sɛ onipa baako bɛwu ama ɔman no.
Petro pa n’Awurade
15Na Simon Petro ne osuani baako bi dii Yesu akyi; nso ɔsɔfo panin no nim osuani no, na ɔne Yesu hyɛnee ɔsɔfo panin no aban mu hɔ. 16Na Petro deɛ, ɔgyinaa mfikyire pono no ano. Ɛnna osuani baako a ɔsɔfo panin no nim no no firii adi bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa a ɔhwɛ pono no ano no, na ɔde Petro baa mu. 17Ɛnna abaawa a ɔhwɛ pono no ano no see Petro sɛ: Wo nso womfiri onipa yi asuafoɔ mu bi anaa? Petro buaa sɛ: Dabi. 18Nso na nkoa ne asomfoɔ no gyinagyina hɔ asɔ gya, ɛfiri sɛ awɔ aba, na wɔretoɔ; na Petro nso ne wɔn gyina hɔ na ɔreto bie.
Ɔsɔfo panin no asɛmmisa
19Ɛnna ɔsɔfo panin no bisaa Yesu n’asuafoɔ ne ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho asɛm. 20#Yoh 7.14; 7.26 Yesu buaa no sɛ: Me deɛ, mekasaa pefee mekyerɛɛ wiase; daa mekyerɛkyerɛɛ hyia adan mu ne asɔrefie, faako a Yudafoɔ nyinaa hyia, na kokoam deɛ menkaa hwee. 21Adɛn na wobisa me? Bisa wɔn a wɔteeɛ no, ne deɛ mesee wɔn; hwɛ, wɔn na wɔnim deɛ mekaeɛ. 22Na ɔkaa saa no, asomfoɔ no mu baako a ɔgyina hɔ no bɔɔ Yesu sotorɔ kaa sɛ: Sɛdeɛ wobua ɔsɔfo panin nie? 23Yesu buaa no sɛ: Sɛ maka no bɔne a, di bɔne no ho adanseɛ; na sɛ ɛyɛ a, adɛn nti na wobɔɔ me? 24Hana maa wɔde homa kyekyeree no kɔmaa Ɔsɔfopanin Kaiafa.
Petro pa n’Awurade bio
25Na Simon Petro gyina hɔ reto gya. Ɛnna wɔsee no sɛ: Wo nso, womfiri n’asuafoɔ no mu anaa? Ɔsanee sɛ: Dabi! 26Ɔsɔfo panin no nkoa no mu baako a ɔyɛ deɛ Petro twaa n’aso no busuani kaa sɛ: Manhu wo ne no turom hɔ? 27Ɛnna Petro sanee bio, na ntɛm ara akokɔ bɔnee.
Wɔde Yesu kɔma amrado
(Mateo 27.1-2, 11-14; Marko 15.1-5; Luka 23.1-5)
28Ɛnna wɔde Yesu firi Kaiafa nkyɛn kɔɔ amrado aban mu; na ɛyɛ anɔpatutu. Na wɔn ara deɛ, wɔanhyɛne amrado aban no mu, na efi anka wɔn, na wɔadi Twam (aduane) no. 29Ɛnna Pilato firii adi baa wɔn nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa sɛ: Kwaadu bɛn na mobɔ tia saa onipa yi? 30Wɔbua see no sɛ: Sɛ oyi nyɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni a, anka yɛamfa no ammrɛ wo. 31#Yoh 19.6-7 Ɛnna Pilato see wɔn sɛ: Mo ara momfa no, na monkɔbu no atɛn sɛdeɛ mo mmara teɛ. Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no see no sɛ: Yɛn deɛ, yɛnni ho kwan sɛ yɛkum obiara. 32#Yoh 12.32-33; Mat 20.19 (Ɛbaa saa no, na Yesu asɛm a ɔka de kyerɛɛ owu korɔ a ɔrebɛwuo no aba mu.)
33Ɛnna Pilato hyɛnee amrado aban no mu bio, na ɔfrɛɛ Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Wone Yudafoɔ hene no anaa? 34Yesu buaa no sɛ: Ɛfiri wo ara wo tirim na woka yei, anaasɛ nnipa bi na ɛkaa me ho asɛm kyerɛɛ woɔ? 35Pilato buaa no sɛ: Meyɛ Yudani anaa? Wo ara wo manfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no na wɔde wo brɛɛ me; ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ? 36Yesu buaa sɛ: M’ahennie mfiri wiase. Sɛ m’ahennie firi wiase a, anka m’asomfoɔ bɛko na wɔamfa me anhyɛ Yudafoɔ no nsa; nanso m’ahennie mfiri ha. 37#1 Ti 6.13 Ɛnna Pilato see no sɛ: Na woyɛ ɔhene ne no? Yesu buaa sɛ: Wo na woreka sɛ meyɛ ɔhene. Me deɛ, yei nti na wɔwoo me, na mebaa wiase, sɛ merebɛdi nokorɛ no ho adanseɛ; obiara a ɔfiri nokorɛ no mu no tie me nne. 38Pilato see no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne nokorɛ?
Wɔbua Yesu kumfɔ
Na ɔkaa yei no, ɔfirii adi kɔɔ Yudafoɔ no nkyɛn bio na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Me deɛ, menhunu ne mu afobusɛm biara. 39Nso mowɔ amanneɛ sɛ megyaa ɔbaako mema mo Twam da mu; enti mopɛ sɛ megyaa Yudafoɔ hene no mema mo anaa? 40Ɛnna wɔn nyinaa teaa mu bio sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi, na mmom Baraba! Nso Baraba yɛ odwotwafoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
